ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the central and anterior areas of both lobes; thick, low-intensity black banding follows the horizontal trajectory of the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 100 degrees; bounding-box depth is pronounced relative to the adjacent lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary; serrations are more pronounced and jagged toward the distal ends of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convexity from the median notch to the outer tips; the curve is relatively flat along the mid-section before tapering upward.
